senses.gloss: m. (צָלַל; cmp. גִּלְגְּלִין, fr. גָּלַל) belt of net work (to support the bosom; considered indecent); bandage, wrap.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 62b:20">Sabb. 62ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 3:24">Is. III, 24</cite>) <he>מקום שהיו חגורות בצ׳ וכ׳</he> the place on the body where they were girt with a girdle becomes full of bruises.

<cite ref="Sotah 8b">Sot. 8ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Sotah 9a:1">9ᵃ</cite> <he>היא חגרה לו בצ׳</he> she (the adulteress) put on a fine belt for his sake, therefore the priest brings a rope &c.; <cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 3:4">Tosef. ib. III, 4</cite> <he>בצִיצִין</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>בצצין</he>; oth. ed. <he>בפנים</he>; corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 6:3:7">Y. Yoma VI, 43ᵈ</cite> top <he>הלבישו … וחגרו צִלְצָל</he> he made him put on an undergarment and girt him with a girdle (like a woman); <cite ref="Menachot 109b:13">Men. 109ᵇ</cite> <he>בצילצול</he>.
<cite ref="Zevachim 19a:4">Zeb. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>צ׳ קטן</he> a small belt (used as a bandage); a. fr.
